scientific_state: provisional with exact conditions and evidence boundaries

question_evidence_ledger.title: Signal processing chain and event word structure: implementation vs theory
question_evidence_ledger.actual_implementation: XIA Pixie-16 modules (100/250/500 MSPS, 12-16 bit) + Avnet MicroZed 7020 (Zynq-7000); 4-word basic to 18-word optional list mode event header; custom firmware discarding waveforms when FIFO full to preserve event headers; MZTIO external trigger logic
question_evidence_ledger.general_explanation: Carrier drift velocity saturation, ideal double-exponential pulse model, Jordanov recursive trapezoid filter derivation, ADC quantization white noise variance Delta^2/12
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: Preamplifier saturation flat-top cutoff, pole-zero parameter M mismatch under temperature drift causing slope/tilt, baseline drift exceeding moving average window
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Proprietary Pixie-16 FPGA/DSP fixed-point truncation/rounding VHDL code, crystal-defect slow carrier trapping response

question_evidence_ledger.title: Energy trigger, timestamp, and CFD: latency, sampling granularity, and precision
question_evidence_ledger.actual_implementation: 48-bit coarse timestamp in Word 1 and Word 2 high 16-bit; 16-bit CFD fraction in Word 2 low 16-bit; LaBr3 timing FWHM 180-280 ps on 250M and 160-190 ps on 500M modules
question_evidence_ledger.distinction: Energy filter latency microsecond scale vs fast trigger latency tens of ns; coarse timestamp discrete clock Ts vs CFD sub-sample interpolation; absolute precision tied to master clock drift vs relative precision tied to jitter and noise-to-slope ratio sigma_n/(dV/dt)
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: Pulse risetime shorter than or comparable to Ts causing severe phase-dependent linear interpolation errors; low SNR causing CFD zero-crossing jitter
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Long-term clock skew monitoring across distributed multi-chassis PXI crates

question_evidence_ledger.title: Local dead time, buffer loss, pileup reject, and global live time
locators: PDF 127-133 (printed 115-121), Appendix B, Eqs (B.1)-(B.10), Figs B.1-B.5
question_evidence_ledger.actual_implementation: Single channel output limit ~80 k/s, drops to ~20 k/s per channel with 16 channels active; PXI bus transmission upper bound 109 MB/s; firmware pileup logic marks 2nd pulse as pileup and drops 3rd pulse
question_evidence_ledger.distinction: Local dead time is front-end shaping window; buffer loss is back-end FIFO/bus throughput overflow; pileup reject is algorithmic discarding to protect resolution; global live is net uncontaminated recorded fraction
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: Beam flash bursts destroying negative-exponential interval distribution, invalidating Poisson live-time correction formulas
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Analytic queuing-theory model for multi-channel PCI bus DMA contention

question_evidence_ledger.title: Coincidence AND joint acceptance non-factorizability
question_evidence_ledger.minimal_probability_formula: P_AND = eps1 * eps2 * E[L1(t) * L2(t) * I(|Delta t| <= Delta T_coin)]; naive product P(L1)P(L2) erroneously squares common busy probability P(B_com=0)^2
question_evidence_ledger.actual_implementation: MZTIO FPGA multiplicity sum logic; 300 ns BGO VETO anti-coincidence gate in in-beam test; logic pulse overlap causing missing gate at high rates
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: Common hardware busy, shared backplane bus, common BGO veto, and prompt cascade physical time correlation violate channel independence
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Closed-form analytic expression for multi-fold cascade under dynamic FPGA multiplicity gates

question_evidence_ledger.title: Branching, DCO/polarization, lifetime selection bias and testable prediction
question_evidence_ledger.testable_prediction: Expanding offline coincidence gate Delta T_coin from 1.5 sigma_t to 6 sigma_t causes apparent branching ratio R_b(Delta T) = Y(low)/Y(high) to monotonically rise and plateau at Delta T >= 3.5 sigma_t(E_low); increasing singles rate from 5 to 50 kcps introduces random coincidence background removable via sideband time gate subtraction
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: Presence of long-lived isomeric state (ns-us) creates genuine nuclear exponential tail rather than instrumental walk cutoff
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Experimental calibration surface of HPGe array angular efficiency and geometrical attenuation factors Q_k

question_evidence_ledger.title: Evidence span from electronic sync tests to in-beam nuclear lifetimes
question_evidence_ledger.evidence_boundary: Pulser timing (<50 ps) and small 1-inch LaBr3 timing (160-280 ps) represent ideal benchtop baselines; cannot impersonate user instrument performance under in-beam charge collection spread (100-300 ns), Compton background, Doppler broadening, and target scattering
question_evidence_ledger.failure_conditions: In large coaxial HPGe detectors, charge collection spread dominates timing jitter, rendering CFD sub-sample interpolation optimization marginally impactful
question_evidence_ledger.uncovered: Long-term radiation-induced drift and cable skew in multi-crate distributed setups
